statement: Candidate cause, not causally confirmed: the fixed stationary-bootstrap mean_block=20 may be short relative to the regime persistence of the momentum-feedback DGP, as one candidate explanation of the MC-V06 futility over-rejection. This is a hypothesis only; it does not establish profitability, alpha, or live readiness.
title: Fixed mean_block=20 as a candidate cause of futility over-rejection
